summary: Align profile and bootstrap acceptance fixtures with miner anchor selection
details: Explicitly use miner anchor gap zero in profile, energy-growth and historical-state fixtures whose assertions depend on the latest committed BTC state.

Prevent startup from waiting on a state before the fixture pass was minted, and keep replacement and max-age checks anchored to the intended boundary. The production default remains two; dedicated mixed-gap acceptance is unchanged.
Expose a retained height and exact state-reference query in the test-only bootstrap indexer so SourceDAO bootstrap, restart and joiner acceptance can mine with the current query contract.
